metadata.sql:
WITH race_data AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_code,
        driver_name,
        constructor,
        position,
        year,
        grand_prix,
        finish_ms,
        LEAD(finish_ms, 1) OVER (ORDER BY position ASC) AS p2_finish_ms
    FROM v_race_results
    WHERE year = 2021 
      AND ((lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil') OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR (lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil'))
      AND position <= 2
)
SELECT 
    driver_code,
    driver_name,
    constructor,
    position,
    year,
    grand_prix,
    (p2_finish_ms - finish_ms) AS winning_margin_ms
FROM race_data
WHERE position = 1
